policy: Every registered suite must pass from the same candidate snapshot before formal publication.

protects: no aggregate identity score, confidence grade, margin, or ranked-candidate output
per-gene expression and detection evidence is retained
major epithelial, T, and NK programs resolve through explicit biological gates
candidate selection uses a documented biological precedence ladder
mixed and doublet conclusions remain separate from cluster-level identity evidence
static red fill is restricted to the Chinese annotation cell
UMAP conflict can reject provisional DC3 and reassign Cluster 7 to Classical_monocyte while Cluster 17 remains DC3
legacy four-sheet or QA-unbound workbooks cannot pass formal copy delivery
blind manifest excludes project priors and cluster-specific constraints
model-facing digest does not leak deterministic core final choices
candidate program alternatives and current-case evidence remain available
blind-test regression remains portable and contains no sample-specific paths or labels
